title: Medical assistant, Ashford Family Clinic
summary: Room patients, take vitals, give vaccines and help with referral paperwork in a busy primary care clinic.
body: Certified medical assistant preferred. Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

title: Clinical pharmacist, oncology
summary: Verify oncology orders, counsel infusion patients and work with the medical oncology team on supportive care.
body: PharmD and oncology experience required. BPS oncology certification preferred.

title: Hospitalist physician
summary: Board-certified internist for inpatient medicine, with closed ICU and specialty backup.
body: Average census is manageable; procedural skills welcomed but not required.

title: IT systems analyst, EHR
summary: Support clinical workflows in our electronic health record, with ticket triage and small build projects.

title: Environmental services attendant
summary: Keep patient rooms and public areas clean and safe on the evening shift.
body: Prior hospital or hospitality cleaning experience preferred. On-the-job training provided.

title: Patient access representative
summary: Register patients, verify insurance and schedule outpatient visits at the main campus desk.
body: Customer service experience required; healthcare registration experience preferred.
